label: 5.1 cm Cuff Turn-Up
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Photograph, 1186x1200 (much the highest-resolution ref in this batch): a navy worsted trouser leg bottom laid diagonally on a white studio ground, real cloth with soft shadow and a visible doubled cloth edge at the bottom-left corner. Geometry fitted numerically: the leg's side edge and the hem edge meet at 89 degrees (square-cut hem), and there is a single crisp tonal step running exactly PARALLEL to the hem edge at a perpendicular distance of 433-435 px across the whole visible width - that is the turn-up's top fold. A genuine turn-up/cuff is therefore unambiguously present, and it is proportionally deep: 434 px against 1155 px of visible hem length, a ratio of 0.38.
